distribution.summary: 福建；贵州；海南；江西；云南；香港
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) describes/records the species from Hong Kong, Tai Po Kau. Lau (2025) independently supports Hong Kong occurrence. Smith et al. (2022) records Fujian, Guizhou, Hainan, Hong Kong, Jiangxi and Yunnan, with locality evidence from Longyan City, Guiyang, Qiongzhong/Jinping, Honghe and Wenshan, thereby adding mainland China records.

host_note: The existing genus-level host Castanopsis is retained. Smith et al. (2022) additionally reports Liquidambar formosana (Altingiaceae), Cinnamomum camphora (Lauraceae), and Litchi sp. (Sapindaceae), which are promoted at their published taxonomic resolution.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Microperus latesalebrinus Smith, Beaver & Cognato, 2020.

taxonomic_history.name: Microperus latesalebrinus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Microperus latesalebrinus was described as a new species by Smith, Beaver & Cognato (2020), VSN_3686.
